scientific_scope: development-only strict-time-OOS test of q(k | T>=7, X), k=7,8,... required by CURRENT V5.2 exact-tail closure. This does not test high-tail D|T, does not create a unified score matrix, and is not a formal promotion.
why_reopen_allowed: different estimand: legacy total_tail_challenger_v470 only tilts public 4+/5+/7+ buckets and does not disaggregate T>=7. C073-A explicitly excludes T7plus. CURRENT V5.2 requires exact q(k|T>=7,X).

source.name: eatpizzanot/soccer-dataset
source.identity_gate: same C071 threshold-8 strict-PIT eligible identity algorithm

label_boundary.allowed_for_this_development: only eligible identities strictly before 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z; these are historical development labels already non-protected in C073-A

estimand.interpretation: r(X) is the per-extra-goal continuation probability after reaching 7 total goals
estimand.tail_support: infinite integer support; numerical enumeration uses adaptive K until residual survival mass <=1e-8

features.same_day_policy: all matches on a UTC date are predicted before any result from that same date updates history

rolling_oos.coverage_stop: if any minimum is missed, STOP_COVERAGE before candidate fitting/scoring for that scientific run

baseline.fit: MLE r=sum(E)/(N+sum(E)) using only T>=7 training rows strictly before the fold test period

candidate.implementation: expand each T>=7 training match to E continuation=1 Bernoulli rows plus one terminal continuation=0 row; fit SimpleImputer(median)+StandardScaler+LogisticRegression

metrics.primary: conditional exact-tail LogLoss on realized T>=7 matches

frozen_gate.league_cluster_logloss_wins: >=50% among leagues with >=50 pooled test tail rows
frozen_gate.probability_residual: <=1e-8 for baseline and candidate on every scored match
frozen_gate.decision: SCIENTIFIC_COMPONENT_PASS_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY only if all gates pass; otherwise FAIL/PARK. A pass still cannot open unified matrix because independent confirmation and T>=7 D|T remain missing.
